name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a Canadian silver-gold development company advancing its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. Diablillos is fully permitted with a completed Definitive Feasibility Study (DFS) and approval under Argentina's RIGI large investment framework, targeting a Final Investment Decision in Q2 2027 and first production by end of 2029. The company has transitioned from explorer to developer following receipt of environmental approvals from both Salta and Catamarca provinces.
